item.title: [Bug] TRAE SOLO crashes immediately on launch on macOS 26 Tahoe (Apple Silicon) — EXC_BREAKPOINT (SIGTRAP)
item.body:
## Bug Report

**App:** TRAE SOLO v0.1.2
**OS:** macOS 26.4.1 (25E253) — Tahoe
**Hardware:** MacBook Pro M2 (Mac14,7), 16 GB RAM, Apple Silicon (ARM-64)
**Architecture downloaded:** Apple Silicon (.dmg)

---

### Description

TRAE SOLO crashes immediately on every launch attempt. The app never opens its UI — it terminates before rendering anything. This happens consistently, even after:
- Deleting and reinstalling the app from a fresh download
- Clearing all app data in `~/Library/Application Support/` and `~/Library/Caches/`
- Running `xattr -cr "/Applications/TRAE SOLO.app"` to strip quarantine attributes

---

### Crash details

**Exception:** `EXC_BREAKPOINT (SIGTRAP)`
**Termination:** `Namespace SIGNAL, Code 5, Trace/BPT trap: 5`
**Faulting thread:** Thread 0 (com.apple.main-thread)

**Crash stack trace (top frames):**
```
0  Electron Framework  cppgc::subtle::NoGarbageCollectionScope::Leave(cppgc::HeapHandle&) + 1564
1  Electron Framework  cppgc::subtle::NoGarbageCollectionScope::Leave(cppgc::HeapHandle&) + 1540
2  Electron Framework  cppgc::internal::StrongCrossThreadPersistentPolicy::GetPersistentRegion(void const*) + 17124
3  Electron Framework  cppgc::internal::StrongCrossThreadPersistentPolicy::GetPersistentRegion(void const*) + 16940
4  Electron Framework  temporal_rs_ZonedDateTime_offset_nanoseconds + 57716
...
15 Electron Framework  ElectronMain + 124
16 dyld               start + 6992
```

The crash occurs inside the Electron Framework itself during startup initialization (`ElectronMain`), before any app logic runs.

**Electron Framework version bundled:** 39.2.7

---

### Expected behavior

TRAE SOLO should open and display its UI.

### Actual behavior

The process starts and terminates within milliseconds with a fatal `EXC_BREAKPOINT` exception. No UI is shown.

---

### Additional context

- macOS 26 Tahoe has been installed for some time on this machine (not a fresh install issue)
- No other Electron-based apps (VSCode, etc.) have this problem on the same machine
- System Integrity Protection is enabled
- Developer Mode is enabled on the device
- The app is not from the Mac App Store (third-party signed)

**Incident ID:** `1C5BC384-2475-42D4-8C20-E239299BC4A7`

Full crash report available upon request.
